final: SELECT gc.gender, gc.order_count, gc.order_count - (SELECT AVG(gc2.order_count) FROM (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed > '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed < '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender) gc2) as above_average FROM (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed > '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed < '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender) gc WHERE gc.order_count > (SELECT AVG(gc2.order_count) FROM (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed > '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed < '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender) gc2)
